confirmation.title: Confirm your email
confirmation.instruction: Open this link on the phone where you registered to finish setting up your account. You can then sign in with your password.
expiry: This link can be used once. If you didn’t request it, you can delete this message.
fallback: If the button does not work, copy this link into the browser on the same phone.
magic_link.title: Sign in to your journal
magic_link.instruction: Open this link on the phone where you requested access to your journal.
recovery.title: Set your password
recovery.instruction: Open this link on the phone where you requested a password reset and choose a new password for your account.
